title: Limit Simulation Method: A Pre-Empirical Framework for Stress-Testing Social Theories
abstract: This paper introduces the **Limit Simulation Method (LSM)**, a pre-empirical methodology for stress-testing social theories by forcing them to operate at extreme scale before any empirical data is collected. abstract: We report a statistically significant elevation of IceCube GOLD alert signalness in the Leo core zone (RA = 120°–150°) compared to the rest of the sky. abstract: We investigate the luminosity distribution of Intermediate-Synchrotron-Peak (ISP) blazars in the Fermi-LAT 4LAC-DR3 catalog (N=246, after redshift selection). title: An Anomalously Variable Subpopulation of ISP Blazars Irreducible to Standard Observational Biases in the 4LAC-DR3 Catalog
abstract: We report the identification of a statistically anomalous subpopulation within intermediate-synchrotron-peak (ISP) blazars using the fourth LAT AGN catalog data release 3 (4LAC-DR3). Applying Gaussian Mixture Modeling (GMM) to 520 ISP sources (ν_syn = 10^14–10^15 Hz) using spectral index, variability index, and synchrotron peak frequency as features, we identify four distinct subgroups. Among these, a cluster of 22 sources (C3) exhibits a luminosity-corrected variability residual of +1.084 (σ = 0.444), compared to −0.105 for the remaining population (KS statistic = 0.946, p < 10^−6). title: A Complete X-ray Spectral Survey of ISP BL Lac Objects in the 4LAC-DR3 High-Confidence Catalog: Evidence for a Rare Spectral Hardening Class
abstract: We present the first complete X-ray spectral survey of all 347 Intermediate-frequency-peaked BL Lac objects (ISP BL Lacs) in the 4LAC-DR3 high-confidence catalog using archival Swift-XRT data. Of 347 targets, 242 had sufficient X-ray data for spectral analysis, yielding 220 objects classified as Class-S (spectral softening; β < 0) and 14 as Class-H (spectral hardening; β > 0). Only one object, **1WGA J0506.6-0857**, exhibits statistically significant hardening at p = 0.037 (β = 2.11, r = 0.90), marking it as the most anomalous ISP BL Lac in the catalog outside TXS 0506+056.
